We need to determine charge(s) for the given facts.

Facts: Chen signed contract to lease 23.26 mu land for rice cooperative. From May 2013 to May 22 2014, built storage, drying facilities without related land use permits. Authorities issued stop notice, penalty, etc. He continued illegal occupation. Measured actual occupied cultivated land 14.79 mu. He was summoned.

This is illegal occupation of cultivated land (耕地). The charge list includes "非法占用农用地". Also possibly "滥伐林木"? No, not about trees. It's about illegal occupation of farmland. So charge: 非法占用农用地.

Check if any other charge like "破坏生产经营"? He built facilities on farmland, but main is illegal occupation. The list includes "非法占用农用地". That's appropriate.

Thus answer: [罪名]非法占用农用地<eoa>
